sources.title: Aligned announces Project Phoenix at Shippingport
sources.summary: September 10 release names a proposed three-facility, 2 GW campus at Shippingport Industrial Park, adjacent to the separate power-station redevelopment. Announces a groundbreaking event; it does not describe a specific achieved physical work stage. The power figure is planned campus capacity with IT/facility basis unstated.

facts.dedicated_power: planned onsite source; adjacent former coal power station redeveloped for natural gas

sources.title: Aligned Pennsylvania campus and PIT-01 address
sources.summary: Operator names its Shippingport campus PIT-01 at 100 Church Lane, Shippingport, PA 15001. Undated service specifications do not establish operation.

facts.address_note: Operator postcode differs from state filing 15077; exact text retained, not used to infer another site.

sources.title: Shippingport Industrial Park site-map page
sources.publisher: Shippingport Industrial Park / Frontier Group of Companies
sources.attribution: Shippingport Industrial Park / Frontier Group of Companies
sources.summary: Property website identifies Shippingport Industrial Park and directly embeds My Maps document 186x-3dU4x2AdQmqnlojErXVzwPcSooE. facts.address_relation: Differs from Aligned PIT-01 marketing address 100 Church Lane; no exact-address identity claim. The named property, not address equality, supplies the bridge.

The directory filing date is not an observation of physical works or a recovered permit-grant date.

facts.pdf_retrieval: Timed out; only the project-detail HTML was captured and relied upon.

sources.title: Aligned Shippingport community construction schedule
sources.summary: Undated page describes adjusting site operations and rescheduling blasting to Monday September 28, with planned dates through October 16. This supports construction preparation context but does not prove any scheduled blast occurred or supply an exact observation date for physical works.
